keyVerseDR: "Love your enemies: do good to them that hate you: and pray for them..." (Mt 5:44)

level1.title: Love Everyone
level1.story: Jesus said, "Love your enemies. Pray for people who are mean to you." God loves everyone, so we can too.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who did Jesus say to love?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me love everyone. Amen.

activity.title: Kind words
activity.intro: Jesus says to love even people who are hard to love. Write a kind word.

level2.title: Love Your Enemies
level2.story: Jesus said, "You have heard, 'An eye for an eye.' But I say to you, do not repay evil with evil." If someone strikes you on one cheek, turn the other also. "Love your enemies, and pray for those who persecute you," Jesus said. God makes His sun rise on the good and the bad and sends rain on all. Jesus said, "Be perfect, just as your heavenly Father is perfect."
level2.keyLine: Love your enemies: do good to them that hate you.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why is loving enemies so hard?
How does God love those who don't love Him?
actions: Pray for someone who hurt me
level2.prayer: Father, help me love like You love. Amen.

activity.title: How big is my love?
activity.intro: Color up the thermometer as you love more like Jesus.

art.mainBrief: Child offering a hand to a child who was unkind
art.heartBrief: Praying hands; names to pray for
